ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Kross Limited has announced the resignation of Mr. Mukesh Kumar Agarwal, an Independent Director, effective July 24, 2026, citing "pre-occupation in family matters." This resignation also removes him from the Nomination & Remuneration and Corporate Social Responsibility Committees, necessitating replacements to maintain board and committee independence. While the company stated no other material reasons, the abrupt departure of an independent director for vague personal reasons, cutting short his appointed tenure, could be a soft red flag warranting scrutiny for potential underlying governance issues.
